description: Verify that TCP in SYN-SENT sends a RST after receiving a segment with an unacceptable ACK number (RFC 793 §3.4 p36)
approach:
[Objective]
In SYN-SENT, the SYN,ACK that DUT expects must have ack_num = DUT's SYN+1. If the ack_num is unacceptable, DUT replies with RST to abort the bogus attempt.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT active OPEN → SYN-SENT.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN,ACK with unacceptable ack_num.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: RST.

[Pass condition]
DUT RST observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT RST

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied RST to unacceptable-ack SYN,ACK in SYN-SENT — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT RST to SYN,ACK with unacceptable ack
